# #194 - Täckning saknas

**Feed**: affarsvarlden-analys  
**Published**: 2026-10-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Affärsvärlden Analys episode 194 runs during Q3 reporting season. The hosts say a negative sentiment wave against AI-linked stocks is weighing on names like ABB, NCAB and Hexatronic even after strong reports. They review Ericsson (neutral, because of memory-chip cost pressure, the Nokia–Nvidia alliance and the SpaceX threat), Ovzon (neutral, low utilisation of its own satellite and dependence on renewing the FMV contract), Softronic (buy, AI-driven shift to fixed-price work, but a weak Q3) and Observit (neutral, a large acquisition with limited synergies and a stretched valuation), and preview the Head Engineering IPO on Spotlight.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 ERIC-B — Ericsson | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

AFV neutral rating; high uncertainty from memory-chip costs, Nokia-Nvidia alliance and SpaceX, though valuation undemanding with net cash.

#### Reasoning

Filip (host/analyst) set neutral: sales ~230bn, 12% margin, ~10x EBIT. Margin may weaken next year unless price hikes pass through on long contracts. Top-10 customers ~half of sales. Nokia+Nvidia claim 2x efficiency vs Ericsson's ~10% AI gains; SpaceX could squeeze operator customers and build own hardware, shrinking Ericsson's 6G role. Partly priced in; Filip prefers other stocks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory chip costs hit margins without price increases
- if Nokia/Nvidia field tests confirm 2x efficiency
- if SpaceX/Nvidia move further into Ericsson's hardware

> *"Det vart ett neutralt råd här på Ericsson och det finns mycket saker som talar åt andra hållet också."*

---

### 🟡 OVZON — Ovzon | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Neutral rating; Ovzon 3 underutilised, backlog halved, FMV deal runs to mid-2027; upside if utilisation reaches 80-90%.

#### Reasoning

AFV analysts (Erik Byström, Daniel) set neutral: market cap 3.6bn, sales ~1bn, ~300 MSEK profit. The satellite is positioned for Middle East needs, but customers are now in Europe. Low order intake. Base case assumes 60% utilisation. Global coverage would need ~2bn per new satellite, likely funded by debt or new share issues. Bure's exit adds to the scepticism.

#### Sell Triggers

- if FMV contract not renewed or shrinks
- if dilutive share issue for new satellite
- if order intake stays low

> *"Själva rådet var att neutral på den här men om de lyckas sälja ut den här som uppåt 80-90% eller något sånt där. Då är nog skalbarheten väldigt bra."*

---

### 🟢 SOF-B — Softronic | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Buy rating; AI could shift IT consulting to fixed-price/value pricing with higher margins; low valuation ~10x EV/EBIT, ~6% yield, net cash.

#### Reasoning

Filip set a buy: senior staff (~400), recurring maintenance contracts for unemployment funds and unions, and the TANON 'software factory' tool point to a possible structural margin uplift from fixed-price deals. Valuation is low (~10x EV/EBIT 2027, 6% yield). Q3 growth was weak (two specific deals, subcontractors), the stock fell ~10%, and token costs were ~3 MSEK. Filip says it is early but he does not read too much into one quarter.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth stays weak in coming quarters
- if token costs cannot be passed on to customers
- if shift to fixed-price models fails

> *"Jag satt i ett köpråd på den här."*

---

### 🟡 OBSE — Observit | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Neutral rating; strong Swedish transit niche, but stagnant recurring revenue, doubtful InSupport synergies and a valuation not matched by numbers.

#### Reasoning

Daniel and Alexander set neutral: market cap 400 MSEK, forecast ~128 MSEK sales and ~20 MSEK profit for 2027. Even with a generous 20% margin, the upside was not enough. Three quarters of stagnant recurring revenue; growth abroad through partners is slow. Axis software and AI could erode the moat. They are on the sidelines watching.

#### Sell Triggers

- if recurring revenue keeps stagnating
- if InSupport acquisition fails to deliver
- if Axis builds competing software

> *"Så det var ett neutralt råd för Observit."*

---

### 🟠 HEAD — Head Engineering | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Upcoming Spotlight IPO, subscription period ongoing; AFV preparing analysis; strong defence tailwind but concentrated order book.

#### Reasoning

Hosts flag the IPO for an upcoming review: 1.5bn order book across four explosives-plant projects, ~330 MSEK sales, ~25% margin. They question the market size and long-term revenue sources. The ticker is not confirmed in the episode (assumed placeholder).

#### Sell Triggers

- if order book concentration not addressed
- if long-term market proves too small

> *"Håll utkik efter analys och IPO-granskning av det bolaget."*
